{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} but my

{07 1c 00}It really bums me out, too,

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 14 00}All right, Mr. Smarty-Pants,{01 00 00 05 00}
so what are they then?{09 09 00}

{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 0e 00}Oh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} So you can't handle
spicy food, is that it?
That must be terrible!
{07 14 00}The problem, {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}, is
that you haven't built
up the proper tolerance.
I work out my belly every
day, swallowing peppers,
chilis, and jalapenos{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 09 00}And even the most pungent
of peppers, the cruelest of
condiments{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0d 00}The tyrant habanero!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 0e 00}Oh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Nii et sa ei kannata
vürtsikat toitu, on nii?
See peab olema kohutav!
{07 14 00}Häda, {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}, on selles,
et sa pole endale õiget
taluvust üles ehitanud.
Ma treenin oma kõhtu iga
päev, neelates pipraid,
tšillisid ja jalapenosid{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 09 00}Ja isegi kõige teravamat
pipart, julmimat
maitseainet{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0d 00}Türann habanero!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 16 00}You've...never heard of the
tyrant habanero? To know
him{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.is to fear him.
{07 13 00}Just one bite can send you
into sweaty convulsions of
flavor-induced ecstasy!
{07 14 00}Assuming, of course, that
you've got your stomach
properly trained.{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 16 00}Sa pole...kunagi kuulnud
türann habanerost? Teda
tunda{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.tähendab teda karta.
{07 13 00}Üksainus amps saadab sind
higistavatesse maitse-
ekstaasi krampidesse!
{07 14 00}Eeldusel muidugi, et su
kõht on korralikult
treenitud.{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 0d 00}Don't worry, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!


{07 15 00}I shall take you under my
wing. Together, we'll train
you to master any spice!{03 01 00 01}

{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 0d 00}Ära muretse, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!


{07 15 00}Ma võtan su oma tiiva alla.
